notes.title: Weekly Update 06/23/2025
notes.notes:
I've been working on Orion and Sirius, a boss from the Dark Forest. During this fight, your ship will leave a "scent" behind that Sirius will use to track you and alert Orion if you're spotted.  You briefly see Sirius wagging his tail in the original game trailer.

notes.title: Weekly Update 6/15/25
notes.notes:
I've got the Fronde ships behaving mostly how I want, and I've moved on to working on bosses for the update.  Currently I'm working on Mimic, which makes clones of your ship if you let it strike you with its barbs.  
  
ZEANIX has the Fronde themes ready, and they are amazing. I'm excited to pair the Fronde ships with the epic soundtrack he has created for them.

notes.title: Weekly Update 6/9/2025
notes.notes:
Sorry that this update is late, we're in a different week now. Nice weather has been causing distractions.  
  
So here's a look at Suncatcher in action. Suncatcher will be a tanky Corvette that is fairly slow but highly resistant to beam weapons.  



The Fronde have been the most technically difficult race to develop. Their artwork is organic, their movement mechanics are not straightforward, and I'm covering them with Unreal's foliage system - which wasn't really designed to move around. Oh yeah, and the tentacles were a pain. It's been fun!

notes.title: Weekly Update 6/1/2025
notes.notes:
Next week 6/6/2025 ZEANIX will be releasing the first volume of soundtrack for the game! It will be available here separately or in a bundle.  
  
I should also have some gameplay footage of Fronde ships. They are coming along nicely.

notes.title: Weekly Update 5/18/2025
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Yw6cYwGpE0k;full][/previewyoutube]
  
I've got the Fronde visuals good enough to share with you guys. It's still not complete and I'd really like the tentacles to collide properly with the ship itself.

notes.title: Weekly Update 5/11/25
notes.notes:
I'm still working on adding Fronde ships to the game. Nobody has brought in any horrible bugs lately so hopefully most of the bad ones are gone.  
  
Next week I'll try to have some images of the Fronde or maybe a brief preview video.  
  
Zeanix is preparing to release the first volume of the game's soundtrack so expect more info on that coming soon.

notes.title: Weekly Update: May 2, 2025
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for helping in the first week of Early Access. Many bugs were found and squashed, and I'm sure there are many more!  
  
Right now I am working on ships for the Fronde race. They are living creatures and move in a different way than the other ships. I also have more bosses being polished up and another mission to add.    
  
In July I hope to release 3 Fronde ships, at least one new boss, and a new mission. If I have time I will also get out a new ship or two for the existing races.  
  
Keep bring me bugs! It's very helpful to get feedback.    
  
And if you don't understand something, feel free to ask me either here or on Discord.

notes.title: Patch 1.250426
notes.notes:
[olist]
[] CLOSED/FIXED Issues

[] Ship unlocks count up every time main menu is entered

[] Counter was not clearing between checks. Because I wasn't telling it to.

[] Getting stuck in objects (Multiple fixes)

[] Added unstuck command to console. In-game pause, go to dev panel, and type "unstuck" (no quotes, all lowercase) and hit enter. You will be moved 500 meters forward.
[] Some obstacles were invisible due to a shader bug. Turns out invisible walls are only fun when I plan them!
[] Removed solid obstacles from DarkForest altogether. Sometimes the best solution is nuclear.

[] Objects spawn on boss

[] Beefed up sweeping for objects around boss area. The boss deserves better than having random junk cluttering their personal space.

[] Rifts causing confusion during missions

[] Turned off rifts during missions. I decided players should only be confused by my game mechanics, not random rifts.

[] Unable to identify friendly vessel

[] Made icon bigger. Because subtlety is overrated when you're trying not to shoot your friends.

[] Menu music continues into library

[] Stopped a case where it would persist.

[] Ship unlock info not making it to library

[] The counter was broken. Made it not broken.

[] Tutorial not moving after targeting instruction change

[] For some reason I had OG Laika in the combat tutorial and not Tutorial Laika. The tutorial was looking for a weapon group that does not exist.

[] "White Screen" when right clicking in main menu

[] Repositioned the alternate view cameras to be outside of Rho (the big orb in the middle)


[] OPEN/PENDING Issues

[] Upgrade text bugs

[] Will fix them as they pop up or I discover them. I decided to do Rich Text on the upgrade descriptions and will probably regret it for years to come.

[] HP/5 permgrade not working (maybe)

[] Investigating.

[] Pause Menu "Ignore Player Assigned" malfunctioning

[] Investigating - The in-game panel does work, pause menu does not. I screwed something up.

[] No reverse

[] Hellbeast reverse thrust was bugged. Investigating for general issues.

[] Caligo-Moonwake ship cannot be seen in ship selection

[] MoonWake is not in the game yet. It probably breaks the game's mind trying to find it in the main menu.

[] Invisible walls?

[] Bad shader and/or material. I'm blaming this one on Unreal. I removed that material and will investigate at some point.


[/olist]

notes.title: Early Access Release!!
notes.notes:
This is the initial Early Access release for GALACTIC WARSHIP. It's a very crude version of the game and I hope you'll see the potential and help me improve.  
  
My plans are: Better interface, more mission-focused gameplay, more ships, more bosses, more cool stuff, more polish.  There's a complete roadmap available here and I'll provide regular updates.
  
Thanks to anyone who has helped so far.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419899/c0ee7bde3cd613f8759b8161ccd53fbbd83df8c8.png

notes.title: Demo Update 04/20/2025
notes.notes:
Based on feedback from NextFest, I've added some features to the demo as I prepare to go into Early Access:  
  
Direct Targeting -  You can now select and enemy directly. Your weapons will attempt to target that enemy if they are able.  

Enemy Info - Information on a given enemy now displays when you hover your cursor over it.  
  
Objective and Enemy Indicators -  Icons will appear at the edge of your screen to tell you where important objects or enemies are in relation to your viewpoint.  Objectives now have a HUD icon that will follow them for easier identification.

notes.title: GALACTIC WARSHIP Demo Release and Roadmap
notes.notes:
I’m excited to finally release a demo for GALACTIC WARSHIP and share my plans for the game. Your feedback and patience are going to be critical to shaping and improving this into the best game it can be!  
  
The Roadmap:
Demo (Today):
•	Three Playable Races – Human, Caligo, Velox
•	Three Ships
•	One Realm
•	One Mission
•	One Boss
•	Limited Controller Support

Release 1: Early Access (April 1, 2025)
•	Nine more Ships 
•	3 Realms with at least one Boss for each Realm
•	More Missions
•	Permanent Progression
•	Upgrade and Story Libraries for each active Race
•	Steam Achievements
•	Better Controller Support

Release 2: Fronde (July 1, 2025)
•	Fronde Race
•	More Ships 
•	More Bosses
Release 3: Occultum (October 1, 2025)
•	Occultum Race
•	More Ships 
•	More Missions
•	More Bosses

Release 4: Apparatus Race (Jan 1, 2026)
•	Apparatus Race
•	More Ships 
•	More Bosses

Final Release: Apparatus Race (April 1, 2026)
•	Fronde Race
•	More Ships 
•	More Missions
•	More Bosses

I’ll provide more details as we approach each release. You can also check Steam Discussions for more info.
